Elio administration

Getting the kitchen ready.

Open dashboard · Team sign in

  1. Configure Elio’s own Resend domain and credentials. Set Supabase Auth SMTP and allowed redirect URLs for the Elio domain and local preview. Email delivery is not connected by this website code.
  2. Create and verify the designated owner’s Elio account. Only the privately configured owner email can claim the first owner role; registering alone does not grant access.
  3. In Flavors and Boxes & sets, enter prices and surcharges. Saving applies them immediately. Use Show this product in shop for boxes and Flavor menus for monthly lineups.
  4. In Daily quantities, set each flavor’s pieces per date. Fixed sets and custom boxes share this inventory. Unsaved quantities start at zero; choosing No limit explicitly means unlimited.
  5. Complete pickup details, delivery zones, payment instructions, and production dates in Shop settings. Keep new orders paused until checkout and customer emails have been tested.
  6. Add verified Elio accounts in Team access. Staff can manage orders and daily quantities; owners also manage catalog, promos, settings, and team access.

Order analytics uses Elio’s saved orders. Website visitor analytics requires a separate Elio analytics connection. Photo upload, payment-proof upload, customer checkout, and order-email delivery still require their integration setup.
